environment.import_method: documentation, wiki and source reading (repository master as read, plus the installed 0.1.565); one empirical project test

input.description: A documented stable mechanism without GUI interaction

expected.summary: Undocumented flags and internal APIs are not promoted into the architecture. NOT_FOUND means the documented/current sources listed in the report were searched and no stable interface was found, not that none exists. Record links and provenance.

observed.summary: OpenUtau.exe has no command-line interface in the source read: Program.Main passes args to the UI lifetime, nothing parses them, and a second instance exits. No wiki page or README documents headless use. Documented surfaces are narrower: the USTX file format (wiki), the Phonemizer API (experimental), Editing macros (documented, GUI), the classic resampler/wavtool protocol, and a DAW integration TCP API (spec v1.2, OpenUtau as client, GUI process required, not a render command). OpenUtau.Core has no UI dependency and the repository's own test project runs it headlessly; PlaybackManager.RenderToFiles exists but depends on the DocManager singleton and a TaskScheduler, and is not documented for embedding.

classification_note: NOT_FOUND means the documented and current sources listed here were searched and no stable or documented interface for unattended open, singer selection, render and stem export was found; it does not prove none exists. Core rendering code exists and is not documented as an embedding API.
